what: A six-track groovebox for the FM-1, forked from Skiff 2.7: a SYNTH with analog, 303 and Plaits-style oscillators, an acid filter and OberVave presets, supersaw unison with stacks, a Minimoog voice, classic drum models, more trig conditions, a step arpeggiator, a multiband compressor, 8-channel USB audio, a DAW plugin, a web editor and the screen on a second monitor.
author: LIkst4
